description: Buy a UK +44 Number eSIM (a real UK mobile line for incoming verification SMS and calls) using the agent wallet balance. Deducts about $25 and delivers a QR from stock instantly. Pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet. Pass request_id for safe retries. This delivers a real eSIM - only call it once the user has confirmed.

api_key.description: The ak_live_ key returned by create_wallet. Pass it here, or as an Authorization: Bearer header.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key - reuse on a retry to avoid a double charge.

name: purchase_uk_number
